acip: DANG PO NI, SGRIB PA LA NYON MONGS CAN DANG, NYON MONGS CAN MIN PA'I SGRIB PA'AM MUN PA GNYIS 'DOD KYANG, SHES SGRIB KYI THA SNYAD NI KHAS LEN PAR MI BSHAD,
wylie: dang po ni, sgrib pa la nyon mongs can dang, nyon mongs can min pa'i sgrib pa'am mun pa gnyis 'dod kyang, shes sgrib kyi tha snyad ni khas len par mi bshad
english: Here is the first.  Now as far as spiritual obstacles, the Detailists do agree that there are two types; they call them “obstacles related to negative emotions” and “obstacles that do not relate to the negative emotions,” and in the latter case they sometimes also use the expression “spiritual darkness” for “obstacle.”  We don't see any explanation which says that they accept the expression “obstacles to omniscience.”
